text:
You need someone to finish the frontend and backend of your AI chatbot website, fix payment processing, and add a reporting dashboard while integrating GPT-3 cleanly into the product.

I’m Noor Halden, and I have 6 years of experience building machine learning and NLP solutions with Python, PyTorch, scikit-learn, LangChain, OpenAI API, Hugging Face Transformers, XGBoost, pandas, and related ML tooling. For this kind of work, I’d focus on stabilizing the existing site first, then working through the chatbot flow, backend integration, payments, and dashboard so the whole system works as a product rather than a set of unfinished parts.

A relevant project was a Delivery support chatbot for Parcelwise Logistics. I built a WhatsApp and SMS assistant that tracks parcels, reschedules deliveries, and hands off to a human with full context. It used Python, OpenAI API, LangGraph, FastAPI, Redis, and Twilio, and it achieved 43% of conversations resolved without an agent, with CSAT at 4.4 out of 5. That project required the same kind of thinking your job calls for: NLP-driven chatbot behavior, tool calling, reliable backend design, and smooth handoff between automated and human support.

For your website, I can help identify what is unfinished, fix the broken frontend/backend pieces, connect GPT-3 properly, and make sure the chatbot experience is dependable. I can also help structure the reporting dashboard so users can see the information they need clearly, and review the payment flow so it works end to end.

I’m comfortable working independently, but I also communicate clearly when the project needs coordination across frontend, backend, and AI behavior. If you want someone who can take an unfinished AI chatbot site and bring it into a working state, I’d be glad to help.
